Subject: Activation manifest & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — draft MAP and timeline

Hi Emma / Procurement team,

Attaching a first-pass activation manifest that ties together the MAP, evaluation plan, and the legal/procurement sequencing we discussed. High-level ask: can you confirm the internal review windows listed under "Procurement & Legal" and call out any additional gating items we should surface to legal (e.g., data locality evidence, specific indemnity carve-outs)?

Key dates (proposed):
- 2027-01-21: Legal kicks off DPA review (target: 5 business days for redline visibility) — Owner: BioFlux Legal
- 2027-01-26: Redwood provides redlined MSA responses & revised order form — Owner: Redwood Legal/Contracts
- 2027-02-02: Procurement issues PO or confirms billing flow (pilot-staging terms) — Owner: BioFlux Procurement
- 2027-02-09: Expected activation of dedicated pilot capacity (subject to MSA/DPA aligning) — Owner: Redwood Onboarding

Dependencies I want to make explicit inside the MAP so sales, CS, and procurement have one source of truth:
- MSA finalization before full production order form signature (pilot allowed via scoped order form + PO)
- DPA must be agreed or a scoping addendum executed before production data access
- Procurement needs cost center & PO lead identified by 1/24 to keep to the 2/2 PO target

Attachment: activation_manifest_draft.pdf (PDF) — includes a one-page MAP with owners, an evaluation checklist, and the sequencing table.

Please reply with any blockers or if you prefer a short 30-min sync to walk the MAP. If procurement prefers, we can draft two flows: (A) pilot activation via PO + scoped order form and (B) full activation post-MSA signature.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Activation manifest & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form — draft MAP and timeline

Irene, thanks — this is helpful and granular. A few quick notes from procurement/legal side after a fast sync with our counsel:

- Procurement timeline looks achievable but we need clear cost center (accounting) by EOD 2027-01-24 — I've flagged this with our finance lead (Joshua).
- BioFlux Legal wants to run DPA first and have a short follow-up on indemnity limits; they're ready to start on 2027-01-21 but will probably need until 2027-01-28 to come back with redlines.
- If Redwood can provide a redline-ready MSA response by 1/26 that will keep us on the proposed path.

I've attached our procurement checklist which includes PO requirements and procurement approver names. A couple of gating items to call out that might not be explicit in your MAP:
- Evidence of SOC2 + sample audit log extract (we'll need these for our internal compliance team)
- Data residency statement for the pilot (we're operating in US/EU zones; need assurance on region mapping)

Attachment: procurement_checklist_BioFlux.xlsx (Excel)

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow if that helps — otherwise we'll respond with redline timings as legal has them.

Best,
Emma Liu
Director, Strategic Programs | BioFlux Therapeutics
emma.liu@bioflux.com

Emma — perfect, thanks for the quick read and the checklist. I've incorporated your procurement checkpoints into the activation manifest and added two mitigations to keep the 2/9 pilot activation target even if the MSA extends:

Mitigation A (preferred): Execute a scoped order form for the pilot (pilot start + limited data scope) and accept a PO in lieu of full MSA signature. Order form will include a conditional clause that converts to production terms once MSA/DPA are finalized. 
Mitigation B (fallback): Delay pilot activation up to two weeks and run a restricted evaluation with anonymized/test data until the DPA is complete.

Action items (owners & near dates):
- Redwood: Provide redline-ready MSA response and DPA clarifications by 2027-01-26 — Owner: Redwood Legal (attachment: MSA_redlines_20270119.docx)
- BioFlux: Confirm cost center & procurement approver by 2027-01-24 — Owner: Procurement / Joshua Patel
- BioFlux Legal: Return DPA redlines by 2027-01-28 (or flag any non-starter terms earlier) — Owner: BioFlux Legal
- Onboarding: Standby for provisioning once PO or signed order form is received — Owner: Redwood Onboarding (Jonas)
